employerFees.description: Government fees are mandatory and non-negotiable. RedBridge and Insight Idea service fees are determined by scope and provided as a fixed quote after the role assessment.

rows.title: Standard Business Sponsorship (SBS) Application
rows.note: One-off fee. Not required if the employer already holds an approved SBS.

rows.title: SAF Levy — Small Business
rows.note: Annual turnover under $10 million AUD. Calculated per visa year.

rows.title: SAF Levy — Large Business
rows.note: Annual turnover $10 million AUD or above. Calculated per visa year.

rows.title: Minimum Salary — Core Skills Stream (CST)
rows.note: Base TSMIT as of current year. Add AMM where applicable — refer to the relevant determination.

rows.title: Minimum Salary — Specialist Skills Stream
rows.note: For CSOL Specialist Tier occupations. Subject to applicable determination.

employerFees.disclaimer: * All sponsorship fees must be paid by the sponsoring employer. These costs must not be transferred to, charged to, or recovered from a candidate, applicant, or visa holder — including 482 visa fees, service fees, and professional service fees.
